definitions.explanation: A chemical agent used to kill or prevent the growth of unwanted plants (weeds). Available in granular and liquid forms, herbicides are widely used in agriculture, gardening, and grounds maintenance.

examples.japanese: {除草剤|じょそうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撒|ま}く→撒く：12711_maku⟧。
⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雑草|ざっそう}→雑草：04996_zassou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{除草剤|じょそうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I used herbicide on the weeds in the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{考|かんが}えて→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧、{除草剤|じょそうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わ→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{草|くさ}→草：02206_kusa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}いている→抜く：02384_nuku⟧。
examples.english: Considering the environmental impact, I pull weeds by hand instead of using herbicide.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{除草|じょそう}→除草：18648_josou⟧ ('weeding; removing grass') and ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ ('agent; chemical'). The suffix ⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧ appears in many chemical product names: ⟦{殺虫剤|さっちゅうざい}→殺虫剤：07036_sacchuuzai⟧ ('insecticide'), ⟦{洗剤|せんざい}→洗剤：03304_senzai⟧ ('detergent'), ⟦{消毒剤|しょうどくざい}→消毒剤：22728_shoudokuzai⟧ ('disinfectant').

USAGE:
- The most common verb pairing is {除草剤|じょそうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撒|ま}く→撒く：12711_maku⟧ ('to spray/spread herbicide').
- Types include ⟦{粒状|りゅうじょう}→粒状：16659_ryuujou⟧ ('granular') for preventive use and ⟦{液体|えきたい}→液体：04134_ekitai⟧ ('liquid') for killing existing weeds.
- Environmental and health concerns about herbicide use are a frequent topic in Japanese news and community discussions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {除草剤|じょそうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撒|ま}く→撒く：12711_maku⟧: to spread herbicide
- {除草剤|じょそうざい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use herbicide
- {除草剤|じょそうざい}⟦{散布|さんぷ}→散布：21064_sanpu⟧: herbicide application
- {除草剤|じょそうざい}なし: without herbicide; herbicide-free

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{農薬|のうやく}→農薬：04295_nouyaku⟧: agricultural chemical; pesticide — the umbrella term that includes herbicides, insecticides, and fungicides
- ⟦{殺虫剤|さっちゅうざい}→殺虫剤：07036_sacchuuzai⟧: insecticide — kills insects rather than plants
- ⟦{除草|じょそう}→除草：18648_josou⟧: weeding — the act of removing weeds, not necessarily with chemicals
